conventions.anchor: quiet lower wall event with zero scalar data and zero geometric mass correction; no imported source-end value
conventions.mass: mathfrak_m_J/ell=m+alpha mu_J+O(alpha^2); alpha=kappa_4 epsilon^2/ell^2; formal quadratic order only
conventions.no_return: chi_U=0 on the retained wall, hence n chi=dot chi; no second independently prescribed characteristic
conventions.normal: outward cap-to-exterior normal (-Udot,Vdot); beta=n R on the reference
conventions.region: one-sided smooth exterior limit of the original wall, x=R/ell in [0.45,0.55], retained sector IV
conventions.traces: w=chi_wall/epsilon; j=dw/ds=ell Vdot J/epsilon; p=w/x; a=dp/ds; b=n_dimensionless p

derived_result.closure: mu_J(s)=integral from s_a to s of L(q) dq+Q(s), with Q(s_a)=0
derived_result.cut_identification: constant background exterior mass makes an order-alpha cut displacement invisible to this coefficient; no vanishing wall displacement is inferred
derived_result.independent_route: L+dQ/ds=x^2(beta t_un-v t_nn)/2 with full Jordan improved stress; acceleration cancels
derived_result.inputs_required: existing leading wall traces w,j and background x,v,beta, clock; no unknown Hessian or perturbed metric enters this coefficient
derived_result.minimal_sign: v>|beta| in the retained trapped sector makes L nonpositive; no late Jordan-mass sign is inferred
derived_result.null_route: both Einstein-frame null fluxes along the same timelike path give L; add the full smooth-exterior frame endpoint Q
derived_result.regularity: L and Q have no division by beta; their beta=0 values remain finite at x>0

domain.radius_proof: F(.55)<=UV<=F(.4), F strictly decreasing in IV

exact_symbolic_certificate.arithmetic: exact symbolic expressions; no numerical mass curve or floating-point scientific evaluation

execution.ordinary_check_scope: stored output, source and declaration authentication only

next_unlock: separately admitted finite mass quadrature and exterior input to coupled wall/cap matching; v8 waveform convergence does not certify this integral
preparation_regularity: C3 compact polynomial; derivative C2; not C-infinity

scaling.amplitude: rescaling all leading field traces together multiplies L and Q quadratically; varying epsilon alone is represented by alpha
scaling.coordinate: independent regular null-coordinate changes leave both-flux density invariant; they do not alter wall proper time
scaling.units: physical mass-length correction ell alpha mu_J; unit relabelling scales ell and kappa_4 as length and length squared, respectively
